purpose: Establish the authoritative sky130_fd_sc_hd__dfrbp definition (clock edge, reset polarity, clocked_on semantics), compare the mapper, the liberty and the behavioural stub, prove the model with a directed test and a negative control, and fix only the confirmed defect

liberty_full.definition: cell ("sky130_fd_sc_hd__dfrbp_1") ff ("IQ","IQ_N") { clear : "!RESET_B"; clocked_on : "CLK"; next_state : "D"; }, CLK->Q timing_type rising_edge (x2), RESET_B->Q clear

liberty_subset.note: ff/clocked_on blocks for dfrbp_1 and _2 are byte-identical to the full liberty; the earlier note that this file omitted them was wrong (corrected in REVIEW_LOG R-06)

upstream_verilog_functional.evidence: sky130_fd_sc_hd__udp_dff$PR dff0 (buf_Q, D, CLK, RESET); not not0 (RESET, RESET_B) — active-low RESET_B inverted into the active-high async reset

upstream_udp.evidence: primitive udp_dff$PR: 'Positive edge triggered D flip-flop with active high [reset]'; table rows '? ? 1 : ? : 0' (async reset) and '1 r 0 : ? : 1' / '0 r ? : ? : 0' (capture on rising edge r)

in_tree_cross_check.note: Yosys read_liberty-generated model of the same cell uses always @(posedge CLK, posedge _1_) with _1_ = ~RESET_B, i.e. rising edge, agreeing with the stub fix independently of the hand-written model

outcome: dfrbp_1 and _2 stubs changed from negedge CLK to posedge CLK; 11/11 test steps pass; the preserved pre-fix model fails 4 of 11 directed checks (exit 1)
interpretation: The stub contradicted the library. The liberty (clocked_on "CLK", clear "!RESET_B", rising_edge arcs), the SkyWater functional model (udp_dff$PR fed by ~RESET_B) and Yosys's own liberty-derived model all describe a rising-edge DFF with an asynchronous active-low clear. The stub used the falling edge. Fixed. No netlist in the repository instantiates dfrbp, so no previously reported result was affected.
limitations: The mapper never emits dfrbp: $dff -> dfxtp_1, $adff (reset to 0) -> dfrtp_1, $adff (reset to 1) -> dfstp_1, and negative-edge registers are handled by inverting the clock into the same posedge cells. The test therefore proves the MODEL against the library, not a mapped netlist that uses it.
No netlist in the evidence tree or RTL instantiates dfrbp (0 in 72 files). The defect was latent: it would have produced wrong simulation results only if a future flow emitted the cell.
Functional only: no timing, no recovery/removal, no clock-to-Q delay, no power pins.
No independent reviewer exists in this environment; every check here is self-run and self-reviewed (G4.4 stays open).

The upstream functional model was read from the archived google/skywater-pdk-libs-sky130_fd_sc_hd repository (read-only since 2024-04-25); no upstream commit hash was pinned, only the main branch content fetched on 2026-11-18.
